evidence.detail: <label class="dropdown seasonchooser"> wraps an <ol>, which is invalid HTML — label may only contain phrasing content per the HTML spec
Two bare <span> elements are direct children of <ol>; only <li>, <script>, <template> are valid <ol> children

.dd-input + .dd-menu and .dd-input:checked + .dd-menu sibling selectors depend on the input and menu being inside the same label — restructuring requires either keeping the invalid pattern or switching to JS toggle
PR 12657 (merged 2024-05-24) improved spacing/semantics but did not fix the label/ol invalid nesting

triage.notes: Two separable sub-problems: (1) <span> inside <ol> is a small standalone fix (change to <li> at seasonchooser.mustache:6-7); (2) <label> wrapping <ol> is structural and requires deciding between CSS-only checkbox trick (accepts invalid HTML) vs. adding JS toggle. The site already requires JS, so a JS approach is viable.
